page_title: What are the things startups have to get right?

sources.entry: What are the things startups have to get right? *(Quora)*

summary.title: What are the things startups have to get right?
summary.one_liner: A crowdsourced Quora Q&A where founders list the things startups must get right (product-market fit, cash flow, team, customer experience) and what matters less (rockstar founders, perfect tech).
takeaways: Product-market fit and a real customer pain come first; many successful startups did not have rockstar founders or first-mover advantage.
Cash flow, unit economics and not burning cash before you have paying customers are repeatedly named as essentials.
Team composition matters: a minimum viable team that can build, ship, market and sell, with complementary skills.
Validate customer demand early through customer interviews and surveys before building heavily.
Answers vary widely in quality and are opinions from individual founders, so treat them as perspectives rather than research.
summary.summary: This is a Quora thread with many separate answers to the question of what startups must get right, including a long answer on what matters and what does not, a checklist-style answer on product-market fit, go-to-market, unit economics and team, and several short founder anecdotes. The answers are informal opinions from individual founders and consultants, and some are off-topic or promotional. The page also contains repeated text blocks from the crawl, so the content is partly duplicated. Overall it reads as a collection of experience-based advice rather than a structured guide.
